Every tool runs instantly in your browser. No signup. No watermarks. No upload limits. No upsells. Built different - Runs entirely in your browser — most tools never upload your files - Free Chrome extensions powered by Gemini Nano (on-device AI, zero API cost) - New tools shipped weekly - 100% free, forever — no paid tier, no hidden
